paragraphs.text: A

The walk described in this leaflet takes you to one of the many places in the district where bricks were made for hundreds of years, until it was closed in the late 19th century.This brickworks is now the largest and best-known nature reserve in the area.Please note that the ground is very uneven, and under-sixes should not be taken on this walk.
paragraphs.translation:
这份传单中描述的步行路线将带您前往该地区众多砖厂之一，那里曾制砖数百年，直到19世纪末关闭。
这个砖厂如今是该地区最大且最著名的自然保护区。
请注意，地面非常不平整，六岁以下儿童不应参加此步行活动。

paragraphs.text: B

This walk will take you to the top of Burley Hill, along a nice easy path that people of all ages will be able to manage.From the summit you can see for a great distance to the north and west, across a landscape that includes half a dozen lakes and the entrance to Butter Caves.Bear in mind, though, that mist often comes in from the sea and covers the hilltop.
paragraphs.translation:
这次步行将带您沿一条适合所有年龄段的平缓小径，登上伯利山顶。
从山顶可以向北和向西眺望远方，穿越一片包含六个湖泊和黄油洞穴入口的景观。
不过请记住，海雾时常袭来，笼罩山顶。
这次徒步将带你沿着一条适合所有年龄段人群的轻松小径，前往伯利山顶。
从山顶你可以向北方和西方远眺，看到包括六个湖泊以及黄油洞穴入口在内的广阔景色。
不过请记住，海上的雾气常常会飘来，笼罩山顶。
这条徒步路线将沿着一条适合所有年龄段人群的平缓小径，带你前往伯利山的山顶。
从山顶向北和向西远眺，你可以看到一片包含六个湖泊以及黄油洞穴入口的广阔景色。
不过请记住，海雾经常袭来，笼罩山顶。

paragraphs.text: C

This route leads you through the village of Cottesloe, which was created in the1930s and is famous for its strange-looking houses and ceramics factory, which is still the largest employer in the area.An artificial lake was originally created beside the village, and has since been filled in and turned into an adventure playground.After you leave Cottesloe, you have a choice of routes to return to the starting point, so either continue via Thurley Park, or if it's raining, take the shorter direct route.
paragraphs.translation:
村庄旁边最初建造了一个人工湖，后来被填平并改造成了一座探险游乐场。
离开科特斯洛后，您可以选择路线返回起点：要么继续经由瑟利公园，要么如果下雨，就走较短的直达路线。
村庄旁边最初建造了一个人工湖，后来被填平并改造成了一个冒险乐园。
离开科茨洛后，你有两条路线可选择返回起点，要么继续经由瑟利公园，如果下雨，则走较短的直达路线。
这条路线将带你穿过科特斯洛村，该村建于20世纪30年代，以其外形奇特的房屋和陶瓷厂而闻名，陶瓷厂仍是该地区最大的雇主。
最初在村庄旁边建造了一个人工湖，后来被填平并改造成了一个探险游乐场。
离开科特斯洛后，你可以选择返回起点的路线，要么继续穿过瑟利公园，要么如果下雨的话，走较短的直达路线。

paragraphs.text: D

This walk is ideal in fine weather, as it takes you to the shore of a lake, at a spot convenient for swimming. Children will want to enjoy themselves in the adventure playground nearby. From there you continue to Starling Cottage, which draws people from around the world to visit the home, from 1920 to 1927, of the poet Barbara Cottam.
paragraphs.translation:
这条步道在天气晴好时非常理想，因为它会带你来到湖边一处便于游泳的地点。
孩子们会想在那附近的探险游乐场里尽情玩耍。
从那里你继续前往斯塔林小屋，这座小屋吸引着世界各地的人们前来参观诗人芭芭拉·科塔姆于1920年至1927年居住过的家。
这条步道在晴朗天气下十分理想，因为它会带你到湖边一处适合游泳的地点。
孩子们会想在附近的探险乐园里尽情玩耍。
从那里你可以继续前往斯塔林小屋，它吸引着来自世界各地的人们参观诗人芭芭拉·科塔姆在1920年至1927年期间居住过的故居。
这条步行路线在天气晴朗时非常理想，因为它会带你到湖岸边一个便于游泳的地点。
从那里你继续前往斯塔林小屋，这座小屋吸引着世界各地的人们来参观诗人芭芭拉·科塔姆从1920年到1927年居住过的家。

paragraphs.text: E

If you want an easy, undemanding walk over flat ground, this walk will suit you perfectly. It passes the entrance to the famous Butter Caves visitor attraction, so you can combine a visit there with the walk, or just take shelter if it starts raining! On the final stage of the walk you pass through Wimpole, the village where Richard Merton, the architect of a number of local buildings, lived for much of his life.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你想要一次在平坦地面上轻松、不费力的散步，这条路线将非常适合你。
它经过著名的黄油洞穴景点的入口，因此你可以将参观那里与散步结合起来，或者如果开始下雨，就在那里躲雨！
在散步的最后阶段，你会穿过温波尔村，这里是一位当地多座建筑的设计师理查德·默顿大半生居住的村庄。
如果你想要一次轻松、不费力且地势平坦的散步，这条路线将非常适合你。
它经过著名的黄油洞穴景点的入口，因此你可以将参观那里与散步结合起来，或者如果开始下雨，就进去避雨！
在散步的最后阶段，你会穿过温波尔村，当地多座建筑的设计师理查德·默顿在这里生活了大半辈子。

paragraphs.text: The Maplehampton scarecrow competition - a great success!
paragraphs.translation: 梅普尔汉普顿稻草人比赛——大获成功！

paragraphs.text: A

There was once a time when farmers all over the country put scarecrows in fields of growing crops. A traditional scarecrow was a model - usually life-size - of a man or woman dressed in old clothes, and their purpose was to frighten the birds away; though how successful they were is a matter of opinion!
paragraphs.translation:
曾经有一段时间，全国各地的农民会在庄稼地里放置稻草人。
传统的稻草人是一个模型——通常是真人大小——穿着旧衣服的男人或女人，其目的是吓走鸟儿；不过它们有多成功则是个见仁见智的问题！

paragraphs.text: B

Maplehampton's scarecrow competition took place on September 12th. Local farmers supplied everything needed to make a scarecrow - like pieces of wood to form a frame, and straw to stuff the scarecrow. The scarecrows were dressed in old clothes which the competitors brought with them.
paragraphs.translation:
梅普尔汉普顿的稻草人比赛于9月12日举行。
当地农民提供了制作稻草人所需要的一切——比如用来搭建框架的木条，以及用来填充稻草人的稻草。
这些稻草人穿着参赛者随身带来的旧衣服。

paragraphs.text: C

The festival was held in the village hall, instead of outdoors as planned, due to the unusually high temperature.There were two classes, one for adults and one for children, all of them working in small teams. Over 20 teams took part, each creating one scarecrow.They were encouraged by an audience of around 50, and had ideas and guidance from local artist Tracey Sanzo.
paragraphs.translation:
由于异常高温，该节日在村礼堂举行，而非原计划的户外。
设有两个组别，一个成人组和一个儿童组，所有参赛者都以小组形式进行创作。
超过20支队伍参与，每队制作一个稻草人。
他们得到了约50名观众的鼓励，并获得了当地艺术家特蕾西·桑佐的创意和指导。

paragraphs.text: D

The scarecrows were judged by a team of people from the village.The winning children's team made a scarecrow that looked like a giant bird - which would surely keep every real bird away! The winning adult team's scarecrow was dressed as an alien from another planet, and its face was painted to make it look very frightening - at least to human beings!
paragraphs.translation:
这些稻草人由来自村里的一个团队进行评判。
获胜的儿童组制作了一个看起来像巨鸟的稻草人——这肯定会吓跑所有真正的鸟类！
获胜的成人组稻草人被装扮成来自另一个星球的外星人，它的脸被画得非常吓人——至少对人类来说是这样！

paragraphs.text: E

After the judging, many of the participants and the spectators had a picnic which they had brought. Some of the scarecrows then went home to their creators' gardens. Alice Cameron, a local farmer, liked one of the scarecrows so much, she bought it to stand on her balcony: she said she didnt need it to scare birds away from her crops, as only bird-scarers that made a noise were effective. She just wanted to be able to see it!
paragraphs.translation:
评判结束后，许多参与者和观众享用了他们自带的野餐。
随后，一些稻草人被带回了创作者们的花园。
当地农民爱丽丝·卡梅伦非常喜欢其中一个稻草人，便买下来放在她的阳台上：她说她不需要用稻草人吓走庄稼上的鸟，因为只有能发出噪音的驱鸟器才有效。
她只是想能够看到它！

paragraphs.text: F
The event raised over 300 for village funds.
paragraphs.translation: 该活动为村庄基金筹集了超过300英镑。

sentence_translations.translation: 标题：展示从宾厄姆市政厅出发的步道地图

sentence_translations.sentence: The walk described in this leaflet takes you to one of the many places in the district where bricks were made for hundreds of years, until it was closed in the late 19th century.
sentence_translations.translation: 这份传单中描述的步行路线将带您前往该地区众多砖厂之一，那里曾制砖数百年，直到19世纪末关闭。

sentence_translations.sentence: This brickworks is now the largest and best-known nature reserve in the area.
sentence_translations.translation: 这个砖厂如今是该地区最大且最著名的自然保护区。

sentence_translations.sentence: Please note that the ground is very uneven, and under-sixes should not be taken on this walk.
sentence_translations.translation: 请注意，地面非常不平整，六岁以下儿童不应参加此步行活动。

sentence_translations.sentence: This walk will take you to the top of Burley Hill, along a nice easy path that people of all ages will be able to manage.
sentence_translations.translation: 这次步行将带您沿一条适合所有年龄段的平缓小径，登上伯利山顶。

sentence_translations.sentence: From the summit you can see for a great distance to the north and west, across a landscape that includes half a dozen lakes and the entrance to Butter Caves.
sentence_translations.translation: 从山顶可以向北和向西眺望远方，穿越一片包含六个湖泊和黄油洞穴入口的景观。

sentence_translations.sentence: Bear in mind, though, that mist often comes in from the sea and covers the hilltop.
sentence_translations.translation: 不过请记住，海雾时常袭来，笼罩山顶。

sentence_translations.sentence: This walk will take you to the top of Burley Hill, along a nice easy path that people of all ages will be able to manage.
sentence_translations.translation: 这次徒步将带你沿着一条适合所有年龄段人群的轻松小径，前往伯利山顶。

sentence_translations.sentence: From the summit you can see for a great distance to the north and west, across a landscape that includes half a dozen lakes and the entrance to Butter Caves.
sentence_translations.translation: 从山顶你可以向北方和西方远眺，看到包括六个湖泊以及黄油洞穴入口在内的广阔景色。

sentence_translations.sentence: Bear in mind, though, that mist often comes in from the sea and covers the hilltop.
sentence_translations.translation: 不过请记住，海上的雾气常常会飘来，笼罩山顶。

sentence_translations.sentence: This route leads you through the village of Cottesloe, which was created in the 1930s and is famous for its strange-looking houses and ceramics factory, which is still the largest employer in the area.
sentence_translations.translation: 这条路线将带领您穿越科特斯洛村，该村建于20世纪30年代，以其外观奇特的房屋和陶瓷厂而闻名，这家工厂至今仍是当地最大的雇主。

sentence_translations.sentence: An artificial lake was originally created beside the village, and has since been filled in and turned into an adventure playground.
sentence_translations.translation: 村庄旁边最初建造了一个人工湖，后来被填平并改造成了一座探险游乐场。

sentence_translations.sentence: After you leave Cottesloe, you have a choice of routes to return to the starting point, so either continue via Thurley Park, or if it's raining, take the shorter direct route.
sentence_translations.translation: 离开科特斯洛后，您可以选择路线返回起点：要么继续经由瑟利公园，要么如果下雨，就走较短的直达路线。

sentence_translations.translation: 这条路线带你穿过科茨洛村，该村建于20世纪30年代，以其外形奇特的房屋和陶瓷厂而闻名，陶瓷厂仍然是该地区最大的雇主。

sentence_translations.sentence: After you leave Cottesloe, you have a choice of routes to return to the starting point, so either continue via Thurley Park, or if it's raining, take the shorter direct route.
sentence_translations.translation: 离开科茨洛后，你有两条路线可选择返回起点，要么继续经由瑟利公园，如果下雨，则走较短的直达路线。

sentence_translations.sentence: This walk is ideal in fine weather, as it takes you to the shore of a lake, at a spot convenient for swimming.
sentence_translations.translation: 这条步道在天气晴好时非常理想，因为它会带你来到湖边一处便于游泳的地点。

sentence_translations.sentence: Children will want to enjoy themselves in the adventure playground nearby.
sentence_translations.translation: 孩子们会想在那附近的探险游乐场里尽情玩耍。

sentence_translations.sentence: From there you continue to Starling Cottage, which draws people from around the world to visit the home, from 1920 to 1927, of the poet Barbara Cottam.
sentence_translations.translation: 从那里你继续前往斯塔林小屋，这座小屋吸引着世界各地的人们前来参观诗人芭芭拉·科塔姆于1920年至1927年居住过的家。

sentence_translations.sentence: This walk is ideal in fine weather, as it takes you to the shore of a lake, at a spot convenient for swimming.
sentence_translations.translation: 这条步道在晴朗天气下十分理想，因为它会带你到湖边一处适合游泳的地点。

sentence_translations.sentence: Children will want to enjoy themselves in the adventure playground nearby.
sentence_translations.translation: 孩子们会想在附近的探险乐园里尽情玩耍。

sentence_translations.sentence: From there you continue to Starling Cottage, which draws people from around the world to visit the home, from 1920 to 1927, of the poet Barbara Cottam.
sentence_translations.translation: 从那里你可以继续前往斯塔林小屋，它吸引着来自世界各地的人们参观诗人芭芭拉·科塔姆在1920年至1927年期间居住过的故居。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you want an easy, undemanding walk over flat ground, this walk will suit you perfectly.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你想要一次在平坦地面上轻松、不费力的散步，这条路线将非常适合你。

sentence_translations.sentence: It passes the entrance to the famous Butter Caves visitor attraction, so you can combine a visit there with the walk, or just take shelter if it starts raining!
sentence_translations.translation: 它经过著名的黄油洞穴景点的入口，因此你可以将参观那里与散步结合起来，或者如果开始下雨，就在那里躲雨！

sentence_translations.sentence: On the final stage of the walk you pass through Wimpole, the village where Richard Merton, the architect of a number of local buildings, lived for much of his life.
sentence_translations.translation: 在散步的最后阶段，你会穿过温波尔村，这里是一位当地多座建筑的设计师理查德·默顿大半生居住的村庄。

sentence_translations.sentence: The Maplehampton scarecrow competition - a great success!
sentence_translations.translation: 梅普尔汉普顿稻草人比赛——大获成功！

sentence_translations.sentence: Maps showing walks starting from Bingham Town Hall
sentence_translations.translation: 展示从宾厄姆市政厅出发的步行路线地图

sentence_translations.sentence: There was once a time when farmers all over the country put scarecrows in fields of growing crops.
sentence_translations.translation: 曾经有一段时间，全国各地的农民会在庄稼地里放置稻草人。

sentence_translations.sentence: A traditional scarecrow was a model - usually life-size - of a man or woman dressed in old clothes, and their purpose was to frighten the birds away; though how successful they were is a matter of opinion!
sentence_translations.translation: 传统的稻草人是一个模型——通常是真人大小——穿着旧衣服的男人或女人，其目的是吓走鸟儿；不过它们有多成功则是个见仁见智的问题！

sentence_translations.sentence: This walk will take you to the top of Burley Hill, along a nice easy path that people of all ages will be able to manage.
sentence_translations.translation: 这条徒步路线将沿着一条适合所有年龄段人群的平缓小径，带你前往伯利山的山顶。

sentence_translations.sentence: From the summit you can see for a great distance to the north and west, across a landscape that includes half a dozen lakes and the entrance to Butter Caves.
sentence_translations.translation: 从山顶向北和向西远眺，你可以看到一片包含六个湖泊以及黄油洞穴入口的广阔景色。

sentence_translations.sentence: Bear in mind, though, that mist often comes in from the sea and covers the hilltop.
sentence_translations.translation: 不过请记住，海雾经常袭来，笼罩山顶。

sentence_translations.sentence: Maplehampton's scarecrow competition took place on September 12th.
sentence_translations.translation: 梅普尔汉普顿的稻草人比赛于9月12日举行。

sentence_translations.sentence: Local farmers supplied everything needed to make a scarecrow - like pieces of wood to form a frame, and straw to stuff the scarecrow.
sentence_translations.translation: 当地农民提供了制作稻草人所需要的一切——比如用来搭建框架的木条，以及用来填充稻草人的稻草。

sentence_translations.sentence: The scarecrows were dressed in old clothes which the competitors brought with them.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些稻草人穿着参赛者随身带来的旧衣服。

sentence_translations.sentence: This route leads you through the village of Cottesloe, which was created in the1930s and is famous for its strange-looking houses and ceramics factory, which is still the largest employer in the area.
sentence_translations.translation: 这条路线将带你穿过科特斯洛村，该村建于20世纪30年代，以其外形奇特的房屋和陶瓷厂而闻名，陶瓷厂仍是该地区最大的雇主。

sentence_translations.sentence: An artificial lake was originally created beside the village, and has since been filled in and turned into an adventure playground.
sentence_translations.translation: 最初在村庄旁边建造了一个人工湖，后来被填平并改造成了一个探险游乐场。

sentence_translations.sentence: After you leave Cottesloe, you have a choice of routes to return to the starting point, so either continue via Thurley Park, or if it's raining, take the shorter direct route.
sentence_translations.translation: 离开科特斯洛后，你可以选择返回起点的路线，要么继续穿过瑟利公园，要么如果下雨的话，走较短的直达路线。

sentence_translations.sentence: The festival was held in the village hall, instead of outdoors as planned, due to the unusually high temperature.
sentence_translations.translation: 由于异常高温，该节日在村礼堂举行，而非原计划的户外。

sentence_translations.sentence: There were two classes, one for adults and one for children, all of them working in small teams.
sentence_translations.translation: 设有两个组别，一个成人组和一个儿童组，所有参赛者都以小组形式进行创作。

sentence_translations.sentence: Over 20 teams took part, each creating one scarecrow.
sentence_translations.translation: 超过20支队伍参与，每队制作一个稻草人。

sentence_translations.sentence: They were encouraged by an audience of around 50, and had ideas and guidance from local artist Tracey Sanzo.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们得到了约50名观众的鼓励，并获得了当地艺术家特蕾西·桑佐的创意和指导。

sentence_translations.sentence: This walk is ideal in fine weather, as it takes you to the shore of a lake, at a spot convenient for swimming.
sentence_translations.translation: 这条步行路线在天气晴朗时非常理想，因为它会带你到湖岸边一个便于游泳的地点。

sentence_translations.sentence: Children will want to enjoy themselves in the adventure playground nearby.
sentence_translations.translation: 孩子们会想在附近的探险乐园里尽情玩耍。

sentence_translations.sentence: From there you continue to Starling Cottage, which draws people from around the world to visit the home, from 1920 to 1927, of the poet Barbara Cottam.
sentence_translations.translation: 从那里你继续前往斯塔林小屋，这座小屋吸引着世界各地的人们来参观诗人芭芭拉·科塔姆从1920年到1927年居住过的家。

sentence_translations.sentence: The scarecrows were judged by a team of people from the village.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些稻草人由来自村里的一个团队进行评判。

sentence_translations.sentence: The winning children's team made a scarecrow that looked like a giant bird - which would surely keep every real bird away!
sentence_translations.translation: 获胜的儿童组制作了一个看起来像巨鸟的稻草人——这肯定会吓跑所有真正的鸟类！

sentence_translations.sentence: The winning adult team's scarecrow was dressed as an alien from another planet, and its face was painted to make it look very frightening - at least to human beings!
sentence_translations.translation: 获胜的成人组稻草人被装扮成来自另一个星球的外星人，它的脸被画得非常吓人——至少对人类来说是这样！

sentence_translations.sentence: If you want an easy, undemanding walk over flat ground, this walk will suit you perfectly.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你想要一次轻松、不费力且地势平坦的散步，这条路线将非常适合你。

sentence_translations.sentence: It passes the entrance to the famous Butter Caves visitor attraction, so you can combine a visit there with the walk, or just take shelter if it starts raining!
sentence_translations.translation: 它经过著名的黄油洞穴景点的入口，因此你可以将参观那里与散步结合起来，或者如果开始下雨，就进去避雨！

sentence_translations.sentence: On the final stage of the walk you pass through Wimpole, the village where Richard Merton, the architect of a number of local buildings, lived for much of his life.
sentence_translations.translation: 在散步的最后阶段，你会穿过温波尔村，当地多座建筑的设计师理查德·默顿在这里生活了大半辈子。

sentence_translations.sentence: After the judging, many of the participants and the spectators had a picnic which they had brought.
sentence_translations.translation: 评判结束后，许多参与者和观众享用了他们自带的野餐。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some of the scarecrows then went home to their creators' gardens.
sentence_translations.translation: 随后，一些稻草人被带回了创作者们的花园。

sentence_translations.sentence: Alice Cameron, a local farmer, liked one of the scarecrows so much, she bought it to stand on her balcony: she said she didnt need it to scare birds away from her crops, as only bird-scarers that made a noise were effective.
sentence_translations.translation: 当地农民爱丽丝·卡梅伦非常喜欢其中一个稻草人，便买下来放在她的阳台上：她说她不需要用稻草人吓走庄稼上的鸟，因为只有能发出噪音的驱鸟器才有效。

sentence_translations.sentence: She just wanted to be able to see it!
sentence_translations.translation: 她只是想能够看到它！

sentence_translations.sentence: The event raised over 300 for village funds.
sentence_translations.translation: 该活动为村庄基金筹集了超过300英镑。

paragraphs.text: How to become a great maker and server of espresso-based coffee drinks
paragraphs.translation: 如何成为一名出色的意式浓缩咖啡饮品的制作与服务者

paragraphs.text: A

Truly great baristas take the time to develop the key skills that will enable them to deliver the highest possible quality of coffee-based beverage and service.As a barista, you must make a concerted effort to listen to your clientele and make sure the drinks you produce are correct in all respects.This is particularly important when you consider the sheer range and complexity of modern coffee drinks, which may start from a single(or double) shot of espresso but can include many additional elements. If you become distracted by the conversation that is going on nearby, you may ultimately miss the mark from a service perspective.
paragraphs.translation:
真正优秀的咖啡师会花时间培养关键技能，这些技能能让他们提供最高质量的咖啡饮品和服务。
作为一名咖啡师，你必须齐心协力倾听顾客的需求，并确保你制作的饮品在各方面都准确无误。

paragraphs.text: B

One thing that separates a great from a good barista is that the former is constantly busy and has a strong work ethic.You will often catch a great barista rinsing out the filter in their machines, for example, as this erodes the build-up of burnt coffee oil that can begin to impact on the quality and taste of each espresso shot. Similarly, do not be surprised to hear the sound of the coffee grinder at work.This highlights the keen attention to detail that distinguishes skilled baristas, as they have the desire and the awareness to make every drink with completely fresh ground coffee.This type of attentiveness helps baristas to get the most from the coffee that they use, as many of the delicate aromas found in espresso are lost when exposed to the open air.
paragraphs.translation:
区分优秀咖啡师与普通咖啡师的一个特质是，前者总是忙碌且具有强烈的职业道德。
例如，你经常会看到一位优秀的咖啡师冲洗机器中的滤网，因为这样可以清除积存的烧焦咖啡油，这些油渍可能开始影响每杯浓缩咖啡的质量和口感。

paragraphs.text: C

Timing is everything when it comes to producing the perfect cup of coffee. A great barista knows precisely when to finish the extraction of espresso, at the point when the balance of flavour has reached its optimum levels. They also understand how important this is; those who act too soon are left with a drink without flavour while those who delay the finish risk burning the beverage and tainting it with a bitter after-taste.

When it comes to customer service, there is so much more to a coffee shop experience than drinking perfectly roasted blends.The atmosphere and the ambience also play a central role, and the interaction that the customer has with their barista sets the tone for an enjoyable experience.Great baristas ask their customers how their day is going or what they're going to do later; they read local newspapers and keep up with issues that really matter, all of which make a real difference in a competitive marketplace.

paragraphs.text: Running a meeting
paragraphs.translation: 主持会议

paragraphs.text: If you're running a meeting for the first time, here are a few tips to help you
paragraphs.translation:
主持会议
如果你是第一次主持会议，这里有一些小建议可以为你提供帮助。

paragraphs.text: A

Prior to the meeting, think about the seating and arrange it in an appropriate way. A circle can work well for informal meetings, but sometimes the furniture cannot be re-arranged or rows are more suitable.Consider the participants and decide what is best. Before people arrive, it's a good idea to designate someone to stand at the entrance and greet everyone.
paragraphs.translation:
会议开始前，考虑座位的安排，并以适当的方式进行布置。
圆形布局适合非正式会议，但有时家具无法重新摆放，或者排成排更合适。
考虑参会人员，再决定最佳方案。
在人们到达之前，最好指定一个人站在入口处迎接所有人。

paragraphs.text: B

If the meeting is small, start by requesting everyone to introduce themselves and to give a bit of relevant information in addition to their name.This may be what they do or why they are there.For all meetings, you need to introduce the chairperson, i.e., yourself, and any other outside speakers you have invited.
paragraphs.translation:
如果会议规模较小，首先要求每个人自我介绍，并在提及姓名之外提供一些相关信息。
这些信息可以是他们的工作内容或他们参会的原因。
对于所有会议，你需要介绍主席（即你自己），以及你邀请的任何其他外部发言者。

paragraphs.text: C

Next, make sure everyone can see the agenda or has a copy of it. Briefly run through the items then take one point at a time, and make sure the group doesn't stray from that point until it has been dealt with.Encourage participation at all times so that attendees can contribute but don't let everyone talk at the same time.Try to keep discussions positive, but don't ignore conflicts - find a solution for them and make sure they are resolved before they grow.
paragraphs.translation:
接下来，确保每个人都能看到议程或手中有一份副本。
简要浏览各个事项，然后逐一讨论每个要点，并确保小组在问题解决之前不会偏离该要点。
时刻鼓励参与，以便与会者能够贡献意见，但不要让所有人同时发言。
尽量保持讨论的积极性，但不要忽视冲突——找到解决方案，并确保在问题扩大之前将其解决。

paragraphs.text: D

Summarise points regularly and make clear action points. Write these down and don't forget to note who's doing what, and by when. Encourage everyone to feel able to volunteer for tasks and roles. lt can help if the more experienced members of the group offer to share skills and knowledge, but don't let the same people take on all the work as this can lead to tension within the group.
paragraphs.translation:
定期总结要点并明确行动事项。
将这些记录下来，并务必注明谁负责什么任务，以及截止时间。
鼓励每个人主动承担任务和角色。
如果团队中经验更丰富的成员主动分享技能和知识，这会有所帮助，但不要让同一个人承担所有工作，因为这可能导致团队内部紧张。

paragraphs.text: E
At the end, remember to thank everyone for turning up and contributing. It can be nice to follow the meeting with a social activity like sharing a meal or going to a café.
paragraphs.translation:
最后，记得感谢所有人的出席和贡献。
会议结束后，进行一项社交活动如共进餐食或去咖啡馆，会是件不错的事。

sentence_translations.sentence: How to become a great maker and server of espresso-based coffee drinks

sentence_translations.sentence: Truly great baristas take the time to develop the key skills that will enable them to deliver the highest possible quality of coffee-based beverage and service.
sentence_translations.translation: 真正优秀的咖啡师会花时间培养关键技能，这些技能能让他们提供最高质量的咖啡饮品和服务。

sentence_translations.sentence: As a barista, you must make a concerted effort to listen to your clientele and make sure the drinks you produce are correct in all respects.
sentence_translations.translation: 作为一名咖啡师，你必须齐心协力倾听顾客的需求，并确保你制作的饮品在各方面都准确无误。

sentence_translations.sentence: This is particularly important when you consider the sheer range and complexity of modern coffee drinks, which may start from a single (or double) shot of espresso but can include many additional elements.
sentence_translations.translation: 考虑到现代咖啡饮品种类的繁多和复杂程度——它们可能从单份（或双份）浓缩咖啡开始，但可以包含许多额外成分——这一点尤其重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you become distracted by the conversation that is going on nearby, you may ultimately miss the mark from a service perspective.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你被附近的谈话分散注意力，最终可能会在服务方面达不到标准。

sentence_translations.sentence: One thing that separates a great from a good barista is that the former is constantly busy and has a strong work ethic.
sentence_translations.translation: 区分优秀咖啡师与普通咖啡师的一个特质是，前者总是忙碌且具有强烈的职业道德。

sentence_translations.sentence: You will often catch a great barista rinsing out the filter in their machines, for example, as this erodes the build-up of burnt coffee oil that can begin to impact on the quality and taste of each espresso shot.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，你经常会看到一位优秀的咖啡师冲洗机器中的滤网，因为这样可以清除积存的烧焦咖啡油，这些油渍可能开始影响每杯浓缩咖啡的质量和口感。

sentence_translations.translation: 这突显了技艺娴熟的咖啡师所具备的敏锐细节关注力，因为他们有愿望和意识用完全新鲜的现磨咖啡制作每一杯饮品。

sentence_translations.sentence: This type of attentiveness helps baristas to get the most from the coffee that they use, as many of the delicate aromas found in espresso are lost when exposed to the open air.
sentence_translations.translation: 这种专注力帮助咖啡师从使用的咖啡中获取最佳效果，因为浓缩咖啡中许多细腻的香气在暴露于空气中时会流失。

sentence_translations.sentence: If the meeting is small, start by requesting everyone to introduce themselves and to give a bit of relevant information in addition to their name.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果会议规模较小，首先要求每个人自我介绍，并在提及姓名之外提供一些相关信息。

sentence_translations.sentence: This may be what they do or why they are there.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些信息可以是他们的工作内容或他们参会的原因。

sentence_translations.sentence: For all meetings, you need to introduce the chairperson, i.e., yourself, and any other outside speakers you have invited.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于所有会议，你需要介绍主席（即你自己），以及你邀请的任何其他外部发言者。

sentence_translations.sentence: Timing is everything when it comes to producing the perfect cup of coffee.
sentence_translations.translation: 在制作一杯完美的咖啡时，时机至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: A great barista knows precisely when to finish the extraction of espresso, at the point when the balance of flavour has reached its optimum levels.
sentence_translations.translation: 一位出色的咖啡师精确地知道何时结束浓缩咖啡的萃取，即在风味平衡达到最佳水平的那一刻。

sentence_translations.sentence: They also understand how important this is; those who act too soon are left with a drink without flavour while those who delay the finish risk burning the beverage and tainting it with a bitter after-taste.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们也深知这一点的重要性；过早结束萃取的咖啡师会得到一杯没有风味的饮品，而延迟结束则可能烧焦饮料，使其带有苦涩的后味。

sentence_translations.sentence: Next, make sure everyone can see the agenda or has a copy of it.
sentence_translations.translation: 接下来，确保每个人都能看到议程或手中有一份副本。

sentence_translations.sentence: Briefly run through the items then take one point at a time, and make sure the group doesn't stray from that point until it has been dealt with.
sentence_translations.translation: 简要浏览各个事项，然后逐一讨论每个要点，并确保小组在问题解决之前不会偏离该要点。

sentence_translations.sentence: Encourage participation at all times so that attendees can contribute but don't let everyone talk at the same time.
sentence_translations.translation: 时刻鼓励参与，以便与会者能够贡献意见，但不要让所有人同时发言。

sentence_translations.sentence: Try to keep discussions positive, but don't ignore conflicts - find a solution for them and make sure they are resolved before they grow.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽量保持讨论的积极性，但不要忽视冲突——找到解决方案，并确保在问题扩大之前将其解决。

sentence_translations.sentence: When it comes to customer service, there is so much more to a coffee shop experience than drinking perfectly roasted blends.
sentence_translations.translation: 在客户服务方面，咖啡店的体验远不止品尝完美烘焙的咖啡豆这么简单。

sentence_translations.sentence: The atmosphere and the ambience also play a central role, and the interaction that the customer has with their barista sets the tone for an enjoyable experience.
sentence_translations.translation: 氛围与环境也起着核心作用，顾客与咖啡师之间的互动为愉悦的体验奠定了基调。

sentence_translations.sentence: Great baristas ask their customers how their day is going or what they're going to do later; they read local newspapers and keep up with issues that really matter, all of which make a real difference in a competitive marketplace.
sentence_translations.translation: 优秀的咖啡师会询问顾客今天过得如何或随后计划做什么；他们会阅读本地报纸并关注真正重要的话题，这一切在竞争激烈的市场中都能产生显著的差异。

sentence_translations.sentence: Summarise points regularly and make clear action points.
sentence_translations.translation: 定期总结要点并明确行动事项。

sentence_translations.sentence: Write these down and don't forget to note who's doing what, and by when.
sentence_translations.translation: 将这些记录下来，并务必注明谁负责什么任务，以及截止时间。

sentence_translations.sentence: Encourage everyone to feel able to volunteer for tasks and roles.
sentence_translations.translation: 鼓励每个人主动承担任务和角色。

sentence_translations.sentence: lt can help if the more experienced members of the group offer to share skills and knowledge, but don't let the same people take on all the work as this can lead to tension within the group.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果团队中经验更丰富的成员主动分享技能和知识，这会有所帮助，但不要让同一个人承担所有工作，因为这可能导致团队内部紧张。

sentence_translations.sentence: At the end, remember to thank everyone for turning up and contributing.
sentence_translations.translation: 最后，记得感谢所有人的出席和贡献。

sentence_translations.sentence: It can be nice to follow the meeting with a social activity like sharing a meal or going to a café.
sentence_translations.translation: 会议结束后，进行一项社交活动如共进餐食或去咖啡馆，会是件不错的事。

paragraphs.text: A

Today, we do not generally associate feathers with the military in Europe, yet history shows that in fact feathers have played an intriguing role in European military clothing. The Bersaglieri of the Italian Army, for example, still wear a bunch of long black feathers in their hats hanging down to one side, while British fusiliers have a clipped feather plume whose colour varies according to their regiment. The Royalists in the English Civil War adorned their headgear with ostrich feathers.'Historically, feathers were an incredibly expressive accessory for men, observes Cambridge historian, Professor Ulinka Rublack. "Nobody has really looked at why this was the case.That's a story that l want to tell.'

例如，意大利军队的贝萨列里部队仍在帽子上佩戴一束垂向一侧的黑色长羽毛，而英国燧发枪团则佩戴剪过的羽毛饰物，其颜色根据所属军团而变化。

paragraphs.text: Rublack is beginning to study the use of featherwork in early modern fashion as part of a joint project between the Universities of Cambridge, Basel and Bern. To the outsider, its preoccupations (her co-researchers are studying gold , glass and veils) might seem surprising. Yet such materials sustained significant economies and expertise.
paragraphs.translation:
鲁布莱克正开始研究羽毛工艺在近代早期时尚中的运用，这是剑桥大学、巴塞尔大学和伯尔尼大学合作项目的一部分。
对于外人来说，其关注点（她的合作研究者正在研究黄金、玻璃和面纱）可能看似令人惊讶。
然而，这些材料支撑了重要的经济活动和专业知识。

paragraphs.text: B

Rublack has spotted that something unusual started to happen with feathers during the 16th century. In 1500,they were barely worn at all in Europe; 100 years later they had become an indispensable accessory for the fashionable European man. In prosperous trading centres, the citizens started wearing hats bedecked with feathers from cranes and swallows.Headgear was specially manufactured so that feathers could be inserted more easily. By 1573, Plantin's Flemish-French dictionary was even obliged to offer words to describe people who chose not to wear them, recommending such terms as: 'the featherless' and 'unfeathered'.
paragraphs.translation:
鲁布莱克发现，羽毛在16世纪开始发生一些不寻常的变化。
在1500年，羽毛在欧洲几乎无人佩戴；100年后，它已成为时尚欧洲男性不可或缺的配饰。
在繁荣的贸易中心，市民开始佩戴装饰有鹤和燕子羽毛的帽子。
头饰经过特殊制造，以便更容易插入羽毛。
到1573年，普朗坦的佛兰芒-法语词典甚至不得不提供词汇来描述选择不佩戴羽毛的人，推荐了诸如“无羽毛者”和“未装饰羽毛者”等术语。
鲁布莱克发现，在16世纪，羽毛开始出现一些不寻常的变化。

paragraphs.text: Featherworking became big business.From Prague and Nuremberg to Paris and Madrid, people started to make a living from decorating feathers for clothing. Impressive efforts went into dyeing them.A 1548 recipe recommends using ashes,lead monoxide and river water to create a 'very beautiful' black, for example.
paragraphs.translation:
羽毛加工成为了一项大产业。
从布拉格和纽伦堡到巴黎和马德里，人们开始以装饰衣物用的羽毛为生。
人们在给羽毛染色方面投入了大量精力。
例如，1548年的一份配方建议使用灰烬、一氧化铅和河水来调制出一种“非常漂亮”的黑色。

paragraphs.text: C

Why this happened will become clearer as Rublack's project develops.One crucial driver, however, was exploration - the discovery of new lands, especially in South America.Compared with many of the other species that early European colonists encountered, exotic birds could be captured,transported and kept with relative ease. Europe experienced a sudden 'bird-craze', as exotic birds became a relatively common sight in the continent's largest markets.
paragraphs.translation:
随着Rublack的项目推进，这一现象发生的原因将变得更加清晰。
然而，一个关键的驱动因素是探险——对新土地的发现，尤其是在南美洲。

paragraphs.text: Given the link with new territories and conquest, ruling elites wore feathers partly to express their power and reach.But there were also more complex reasons. Ln 1599, for example, Duke Frederick of Württemberg held a display at his court at which he personally appeared wearing a costume covered in exotic feathers and representing the Americas. This was not just a symbol of power, but of cultural connectedness, Rublack suggests: 'The message seems to be that he was embracing the global in a duchy that was quite insular and territorial.’
paragraphs.translation:
鉴于羽毛与新领土和征服之间的联系，统治精英佩戴羽毛部分是为了展示他们的权力和影响力。
但还有更复杂的原因。
例如，1599年，符腾堡公爵腓特烈在其宫廷举办了一场展示，他本人身着覆盖着异域羽毛、代表美洲的服装出场。
鲁布拉克认为，这不仅是权力的象征，也是文化联系的象征：“其信息似乎是，他在一个相当封闭且以领土为重的公国里拥抱全球。”

paragraphs.text: D

Nor were feathers worn by the powerful alone. In 1530,a legislative assembly at Augsburg imposed restrictions on peasants and traders adopting what it clearly felt should be an elite fashion.The measure did not last, perhaps because health manuals of the era recommended feathers could keep the wearer safe from ‘bad' air - cold, miasma, damp or excessive heat - all of which were regarded as hazardous. During the 1550s, Eleanor of Toledo had hats made from peacock feathers to keep her dry in the rain. Gradually, feathers came to indicate that the wearer was healthy and civllised. Artists and musicians took to wearing them as a mark of subtlety and style.
paragraphs.translation:

1530年，奥格斯堡的一次立法会议对农民和商人采用这种它显然认为应为精英时尚的服饰施加了限制。

paragraphs.text: E

As with most fads, this enthusiasm eventually wore off. By the mid-17th century, feathers were out of style, with one striking exception. Within the armies of Europe feathers remained an essential part of military costume.
paragraphs.translation:
与大多数时尚潮流一样，这种热情最终消退。
到了17世纪中期，羽毛已不再流行，唯有一个显著的例外。
在欧洲军队中，羽毛仍是军装的重要组成部分。

paragraphs.text: Rublack thinks that there may have been several reasons for this strange contradiction. 'It's associated with the notion of graceful warfaring,' she says. 'This was a period when there were no standing armies and it was hard to draft soldiers. One solution was to aestheticise the military, to make it seem graceful and powerful.' Feathers became associated with the idea of an art of warfare.
paragraphs.translation:
鲁布拉克认为这种奇怪的矛盾可能有几个原因。
她说：“这与优雅战争的概念有关。”
“这是一个没有常备军且征兵困难的时期。”
“一种解决方案是美化军队，使其显得优雅而强大。”
羽毛于是与战争艺术的概念联系起来。

paragraphs.text: They were also already a part of military garb among many native American peoples and in the Ottoman empire. Rublack believes that just as some of these cultures considered the feathers of certain birds to be highly significant,and sometimes sacred,European soldiers saw the feathers as imparting noble passions, bravery and courage.
paragraphs.translation:
它们也早已是许多美洲原住民和奥斯曼帝国军事服装的一部分。
鲁布莱克认为，正如其中一些文化认为某些鸟类的羽毛非常重要，有时甚至神圣一样，欧洲士兵也视羽毛为赋予高贵情感、勇敢和勇气的象征。

paragraphs.text: F

In time, her research may therefore reveal a tension about the ongoing use of feathers in this unlikely context.But, as she also notes, she is perhaps the first historian to have spotted the curious emotional resonance of feathers in military fashion at all. All this shows a sea-change in methodologies: historians now chart the ways in which our identities are shaped through deep connections with ‘stuff’ the material objects that are parts of our lives.
paragraphs.translation:
但正如她也指出的，她或许是有史以来第一位注意到羽毛在军事时尚中奇特情感共鸣的历史学家。
所有这些都体现了方法论上的巨大转变：历史学家们如今描绘的是，我们的身份如何通过与“物质”——即构成我们生活一部分的物品——的深层联系而被塑造出来。
